author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನಳಿವು ಉಳಿವುಗಳ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಪನೊಬ್ಬನಿಹ
ನಿನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಕುಳಿತಿರುವ ಸೂತ್ರಧಾರನವ
ನಿನ್ನ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯೆಲ್ಲ ಅವನಂತೆ ನಡೆಯುತಿರೆ
ನಿನ್ನತನವೇನಿಹುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There is one who decides your end and your survival;
he is the puppeteer seated within you;
if all your words and deeds go as he wills,
what is left of your ‘self’, O deluded one?
en.bhavartha: The Divine within decides our fate and pulls the strings. If everything we do follows that will, what room is left for ego?
